verdict.rationale: Drata's API exposes Controls, Custom Connections, and Monitoring Tests endpoints, implying some ability to extend beyond built-in integrations and connect custom evidence sources, but there is no documentation of creating custom compliance frameworks or authoring custom tests with defined evidence requirements as a first-class feature. Missing for 10: explicit 'create custom framework' capability, custom control/test authoring with evidence-requirement definitions, and any independent confirmation that customers actually build full custom frameworks in Drata.
